name: Cadastral Digitizer — BhuNaksha & GIS
description: Digitize cadastral and GIS parcels on any portal, or from a scanned sheet, image or PDF page. Colour tracing, batch vectorisation, draggable ground control points with cross-validated georeferencing, topology clean-up, and DXF / KMZ / GeoJSON / Shapefile / WKT / CSV export. Developed by Md Salim Ansari. MIT licensed.
author: Md Salim Ansari
